issues.body: The new text says "The corpus is now exhaustively covered," but the same diff states that one of the 493 TestCase nodes is untagged. collect_cases_for selects only DIRECT or RDF-BASED cases, excludes Rejected cases, and additionally requires a recognized check kind or ProfileIdentificationTest typing. Those omitted cases/documents are not measured by either round-trip arm. The disjointness canary proves that the two selected semantic slices do not overlap; it does not prove that their union covers the entire export corpus.
issues.fix_hint: Narrow the claim to exhaustive coverage of eligible, non-rejected cases sanctioned as DIRECT or RDF-BASED, or add a separately pinned accounting/test for every excluded category and only call the full export exhaustive if all ontology-document slots are actually covered.
issues.title: Exhaustive corpus coverage claim is contradicted by the selection logic

verdict.summary: The RDF-BASED-only selector and its offline canary correctly exercise the intended disjointness, but the documentation overstates the resulting coverage. The diff itself records an untagged test case, while collect_cases_for also excludes rejected cases and cases lacking the recognized check/profile kinds. Therefore the claim that the corpus is now exhaustively covered does not follow from the implementation or tests.
